data.gender_notes: Naisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Naisha is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'naas' which means to lead or to give. In Hindu mythology, Naisha is a name given to various goddesses, representing motherhood, compassion, and nurturing energy. The name Naisha carries the meaning “Lady, Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Naisha usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naisha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
